title: Hungover Healing Mexican Milk Chiles Rellenos
description: A citrusy and refreshing Yucatecan dish featuring semi-skimmed milk and fermented ingredients to help cure hangovers, this satvik-friendly recipe is a unique twist on traditional chiles rellenos.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Roast the Anaheim peppers in the oven for 20 minutes, then peel off the skin and remove the seeds.
In a blender, combine the chilled semi-skimmed milk, lime juice, plain yogurt, honey, salt, and black pepper, and blend until smooth.
Stuff each roasted pepper with the milk mixture and place on a baking dish.
Bake the stuffed peppers in the oven for 15 minutes, or until the filling is set.
Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro and serve warm.
Let the dish cool to room temperature before refrigerating or freezing.
Reheat the dish gently before serving, if desired.
